name: God's Special Children Christmas Mass & Party
description: Annual Christmas Mass and party for God's Special Children and their families, hosted by the Knights and the Daughters. Rebuilt from the 2025 run (Danny Thiele).

tasks.title: Knights detailed help request + volunteer sign-up
tasks.sms: Hi {{first}}, {{coord.first}} here. Please forward the GSC Christmas Party help request to our council. I emailed it to you. Details: {{link}}

email.subject: God's Special Children's Christmas Mass and Party - Knights Help Request
email.body:
{{first}}, please forward this help request to our council. Thanks!!!

- - -

God's Special Children's Christmas Mass and Party
Knights Help Request
{{date -1}} and {{date 0}}

Our council needs help to successfully host the God's Special Children's Christmas Party. This is our biggest and most attended event of the year for intellectually and developmentally challenged people.

{{date -1}}, 3:00 to 6:00 PM.
Set up and decorate {{venue}} with the Daughters. This also gives us an opportunity to get presents and leftover decorations for our Santa station.

{{date 0}}, 12:30 - 1:00 PM.
We need 5-8 men to set up the cooking area and help prep the food, make the jambalaya, grill the hamburgers and hotdogs.

{{date 0}}, 2:00 PM.
God's Special Children's Christmas Mass.

{{date 0}}, 3:00 PM.
Christmas Party in {{venue}}. We will need a few Knights to help serve and assist our special needs guests and their families. Try to interact with the families offering more food or just saying hello. If you can, wear your council shirt to show our support to these families.

{{date 0}}, 4:30 - 5:30 PM.
We will need 5-8 men to help break down and clean up {{venue}} after the party. The more men we have the faster it goes.

PLEASE SIGN UP for a time slot: call or text me at {{coord.phone}}, or reply to this email with your name, phone number and the time slots you can help with.

Through hard work, St. Francis Xavier Knights of Columbus has earned the reputation in the archdiocese and recognized by state leaders as the God's Special Children council. We must continue our dedication to maintain this honor. Please help our council throw the best Christmas party for our God's Special Children and their families. For many this will be their only Christmas Party.

{{signature}}
